editorial:
Imagine a world where wives decide they have had enough of their husbands' nonsense and go on a full-blown strike. You get a funny, lighthearted look at early marriage struggles that feels like a chaotic game of cat and mouse. The vibe is all about silly misunderstandings and the power struggle between partners, making it feel like a vintage sitcom. You will see characters trying to navigate their domestic lives while the rules of the house suddenly change, leading to some really goofy situations that still land well today.

What really works here is the physical comedy and the way the actors play up the frustration. While the pacing is a bit slower than modern films, the charm makes up for it. If you enjoy old-school humor, you should definitely check this out.
